patterns.note: Content is organized into distinct, often full-height, sections that scroll sequentially, creating a clear progression through the site's narrative.
A strong typographic hierarchy uses oversized, bold sans-serif headings for impact, complemented by smaller, uppercase monospaced text for labels and metadata.
A high-contrast palette features a light, almost off-white background, a deep, vibrant blue for accents and calls to action, and stark dark text.

The header (logo and menu) remains sticky at the top of the viewport while content sections scroll vertically. A full-screen blue section acts as an interstitial experience, scrolling into and out of view between other content blocks.
Subtle grid lines are used as visual dividers and alignment guides, particularly noticeable in the background of content sections, reinforcing a structured and precise aesthetic.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls. Main content areas are designed as distinct, full-height sections that scroll sequentially, with one section replacing the previous one in the viewport. An interstitial full-screen section with a solid background color scrolls in and out of view, creating a dramatic transition between content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold hero headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, uppercase monospaced labels for section numbers and metadata.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between major content sections and a balanced rhythm established by subtle grid lines.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-screen, sequentially scrolling content blocks, particularly the vibrant blue interstitial section, creates a highly structured and impactful user experience. This, combined with bold, editorial typography and a minimalist grid, gives the site a precise and authoritative feel that stands apart from typical marketing templates.
